IS_EMAIL: $t(properties.{property}) must be a valid email address.
IS_PHONE: $t(properties.{property}) must be a valid phone number, for example +964 750 123 4567.
IS_MONEY: $t(properties.{property}) must be an amount with at most 2 decimals.
PASSWORD_PATTERN: $t(properties.{property}) must be {min}-{max} characters with no spaces and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
USERNAME_PATTERN: $t(properties.{property}) must be 3-30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, _ or .
DATE_PATTERN: $t(properties.{property}) must be a real date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
TIME_PATTERN: $t(properties.{property}) must be a time in the format HH:mm, for example 08:30.
PLATE_PATTERN: $t(properties.{property}) can only contain letters, numbers, spaces and dashes (2-15 characters).
LEVEL_PATTERN: $t(properties.{property}) must be a level like B1, G or F1.
INVALID_ID: The id in the URL must be a whole number greater than 0.
